A 39-year-old woman has noted a 'bump' on her neck for the past 6 months. On physical examination there is a firm, well-circumscribed, non-tender nodule to the right of midline in her neck. She undergoes thyroidectomy and the microscopic appearance of the lesion is shown here. Which of the following statements regarding her disease is most appropriate? <image> 

(A) The serum TSH is probably increased
(B) She will probably survive for at least 10 years
(C) Anti-microsomal and anti-thyroglobulin antibodies are detectable
(D) A dietary iodine deficiency probably preceded its appearance
(E) The patient has relatives with a similar condition

Answer with the option's letter from the given choices directly.
